mapper.sql: select o.outline_id, o.work_id, o.outline_level, o.parent_id, o.seq_no, o.outline_title, o.outline_content, o.chapter_id, c.chapter_no, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from ai_novel_outline o left join ai_novel_chapter c on c.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and c.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where o.work_id = #{workId} and o.del_flag = '0' order by o.outline_level, o.seq_no asc, o.outline_id asc
where o.work_id = #{workId} and o.outline_level = #{outlineLevel} and o.del_flag = '0' order by o.seq_no asc, o.outline_id asc
where o.work_id = #{workId} and o.parent_id = #{parentId} and o.del_flag = '0' order by o.seq_no asc, o.outline_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_novel_outline (work_id, outline_level, parent_id, seq_no, outline_title, outline_content, chapter_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{workId}, #{outlineLevel}, #{parentId}, #{seqNo}, #{outlineTitle}, #{outlineContent}, #{chapterId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update ai_novel_outline set seq_no = #{seqNo}, update_time = now() where outline_id = #{outlineId} and work_id = #{workId} and del_flag = '0'
update ai_novel_outline set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where outline_id = #{outlineId} and work_id = #{workId} and del_flag = '0'
